title: Constructible etale modules for discrete Noetherian coefficients
statement:
Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $\Lambda$ a discrete commutative Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]. Use the universes and small skeletons of [def-weil-size-convention]. On its small etale site $X_{\mathrm{et}}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], write $\underline\Lambda_X$ for the constant sheaf of rings [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf], and use sheaves of $\underline\Lambda_X$-modules and their linear morphisms [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Such a module sheaf $F$ is constructible if, for every affine open $U\subseteq X$, there is a finite partition $U=\coprod_{a=1}^n Z_a$ into constructible locally closed subschemes (a scheme stratification [def-constructible-stratification], including its schemes and immersion maps): their underlying subsets are constructible in $U$ [def-weil-constructible-subset], locally closed [def-weil-locally-closed-subset], pairwise disjoint, and cover $U$. For each inclusion $i_a:Z_a\to X$, the inverse-image restriction $i_a^{-1}F$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] must admit an etale covering $\{V_{ab}\to Z_a\}_b$ and isomorphisms $(i_a^{-1}F)|_{V_{ab}}\cong\underline{M_{ab}}_{V_{ab}}$ of module sheaves, where $M_{ab}$ are finitely generated $\Lambda$-modules [def-weil-finitely-generated-module] and the right side is the sheafification of the constant presheaf with value $M_{ab}$ [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf], with its induced $\underline\Lambda_{V_{ab}}$-module structure. Finite generation refers to modules, and does not require their underlying sets to be finite. The constructible etale module category has these sheaves as objects and all module-sheaf morphisms between them as morphisms, with identities and composition inherited from the ambient module-sheaf category (the full subcategory).

Write $D^b_c(X_{\mathrm{et}},\Lambda)$ for the full subcategory of the derived category of the ambient abelian category of all sheaves of $\underline\Lambda_X$-modules on $X_{\mathrm{et}}$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] whose objects $K$ have constructible cohomology sheaves $H^q(K)$ for every integer $q$ and $H^q(K)=0$ outside some finite interval. Here full subcategory again means that all ambient derived morphisms between the specified objects are retained, with inherited identities and composition. No completeness condition is imposed.

split_report.summary: Audited this definition against Stacks 03RW(3), 03RU and the definition of D_c in 09AL. Retained arbitrary schemes and arbitrary discrete commutative Noetherian coefficients, affine-local finite constructible partitions, finitely generated module models rather than finite sets, and globally bounded cohomology without completeness. Reused the existing definition nodes, adding explicit small-universe and scheme-stratification dependencies and expanding constant module sheaves and full-subcategory morphisms. No new nodes and no proof steps are needed for this definition. Source Lean imposes a single global stratification and therefore is not an exact attachment.
split_report.blueprint: The source category of the constructible-sheaf equivalence and D^b_c(X_Et,Lambda) in the statement of sk-thm-pe-constructible-comparison; these are notions for the comparison, not a replacement of its proof route. Whole-blueprint searches for constructible, constructible etale, constructible sheaf, Noetherian ring and finite stratification found no imported definition with the same arbitrary-scheme, Noetherian-coefficient etale scope and both clauses. same_as remains empty.

lean.statement: def IsCoefficientConstructibleEtaleModule (X : Scheme.{u}) (A : Type (max v (u + 1))) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] (F : CategoryTheory.ConstantCompletion.Mod (CategoryTheory.ConstantCompletion.constant (smallModelComparisonEtaleTopology.{u, v} X) A)) : Prop
lean.note: §1(B), H3 repair: the recorded interface ties coefficients to the scheme universe. This module publicly retains that interface and supplies the identical notion on the equivalent coefficient-sized AsSmall sites, with A : Type (max v (u+1)). Constructibility is affine-local, uses the recorded locally closed scheme stratification, and trivializes by finitely generated constant modules on the equivalent localized etale sites. The full categories and bounded constructible category retain all ambient morphisms. Rework restoration (C1, 2026-10-21): the retired LocallyClosedStratification in the coefficient-sized predicate is replaced by the current recorded Scheme.FiniteLocallyClosedStratification, imported publicly. Explicit constructibility, all scheme realizations, and the affine-local condition are retained. The Lean signature and all nine declarations are unchanged; no proof dependencies or unit route change.
